title: Mode-specific payment dates in reports (UI + CSV export)

requirements.summary: Send mode-specific payment dates (chequeDate / bankTransferDate) from Payment Entry and Edit Payment screens via existing add/edit payment mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend PaymentEntry includes optional fields for chequeDate and bankTransferDate (both nullable/optional).
backend/main.mo addPayment accepts and stores chequeDate and bankTransferDate when applicable.
backend/main.mo editPayment accepts and updates chequeDate and bankTransferDate when applicable.
Payment entry UI (PaymentEntryPage) sends chequeDate for cheque lines and transferDate for online lines to the backend.
Edit payment UI (EditPaymentEntryPage) allows admins to view/update the mode-specific date field for the selected mode and sends it to the backend.
Existing payment entries that predate this change continue to work with missing (null) chequeDate/bankTransferDate values.

file_operations.description: Add shared frontend helpers to (1) derive the effective Payment Date from a PaymentEntry (bankTransferDate/chequeDate/createdTimestamp fallback) and (2) convert an HTML date input value (YYYY-MM-DD) into backend Time (nanoseconds) for chequeDate/bankTransferDate.

Extend useAddPayment and useEditPayment mutations to accept chequeDate and bankTransferDate variables and pass them into actor.addPayment / actor.editPayment calls (as Time | null) so the frontend can persist the entered mode-specific dates.

When submitting each payment line, convert and send the mode-specific date: send chequeDate for cheque lines, send bankTransferDate for online (NEFT/RTGS/UPI) lines, and send null for other modes; keep existing validation behavior and ensure older flows still work when dates are absent.

Add a conditional date input for the selected paymentMode (Cheque Date for cheque, Transfer Date for bank transfer), prefill it when available from the payment record, validate when required, and submit it via useEditPayment as chequeDate/bankTransferDate (Time | null).

requirements.summary: Display a conditional Payment Date in the on-screen Reports ledger table based on payment mode.
acceptanceCriteria: RetailerLedgerTable shows a Payment Date column/value derived as: bankTransferDate (if mode=bankTransfer and present) else chequeDate (if mode=cheque and present) else createdTimestamp.
When the relevant mode-specific date is not present (older records), the UI falls back to createdTimestamp without errors.
Displayed date formatting remains consistent with existing report date formatting (en-IN locale).

file_operations.description: Update the table to show a single "Payment Date" column using the shared helper to derive the effective date per row (bankTransferDate/chequeDate/createdTimestamp fallback), keeping existing en-IN date formatting and ensuring null/undefined dates do not throw.
Ensure the helper that derives the effective Payment Date supports missing optional fields (older records) and returns createdTimestamp as a safe fallback.

requirements.summary: Update the exported CSV report to include a conditional "Payment Date" column matching on-screen semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: exportReportsToXlsx adds/updates a CSV column named "Payment Date" populated as: bankTransferDate (bank transfer) else chequeDate (cheque) else createdTimestamp.
Export succeeds without runtime errors when mode-specific dates are null/missing.
CSV values for Payment Date match the on-screen semantics for the same payment rows.

file_operations.description: Update the CSV header to include a "Payment Date" column (replacing the current createdTimestamp-based date column value) and populate it using the shared effective-date helper while keeping all other existing export columns and ordering unchanged; handle missing optional date fields safely.
Expose a reusable function to compute the effective Payment Date timestamp for export usage so the CSV semantics match the on-screen ledger semantics.
